name: The Rev. Miriam Achterberg
office_hours: Tuesday to Thursday, 10:00 to 15:00, in the parish office
summary: The parish priest. Preaches most Sundays, runs the vestry and visits anyone who asks.
bio: Miriam came to Wyndleford from a hospital chaplaincy in Duluth. She walks to church, keeps bees behind the rectory, and will talk about the Gospel of Mark for as long as you let her.

name: The Rev. Tobias Nwankwo-Hale
office_hours: Monday and Wednesday afternoons, or after the 10:30 on Sunday
summary: Leads the youth, the Wednesday study and the young adults supper.
bio: Tobias grew up in Lagos and Leeds and was ordained in Chicago. He coaches the parish five-a-side team and plays bass in the Christmas Eve band.

name: The Rev. Ruth Pellingham
office_hours: Sunday mornings; weekdays she is chaplain at Wend Valley General
summary: Coordinates pastoral care, hospital visits and the prayer list.
bio: Ruth is a hospital chaplain during the week and the parish deacon on Sundays, which means she reads the Gospel, sets the table and sends everyone out the door at the end.

name: Owen Marchetti-Kaye
summary: Runs the Wyndleford Choir, the children's choir and the 1911 Hollins organ.
bio: Owen has played the Hollins organ for fourteen years and has strong opinions about the tempo of Hark! The Herald Angels Sing.

name: Hana Yoshiro-Bell
office_hours: Sunday 9:15 to 12:30 in the Lantern Room
summary: Leads Sunday school in the Lantern Room, the pageant and the parents' circle.
bio: Hana taught second grade for twelve years. She writes the Christmas pageant script every year and has never once had enough sheep costumes.

name: Delphine Okoro
summary: Keeps the calendar, the directory, the rota and the building bookings.
bio: If you need a room, a key, a baptism date or the name of the person who makes the coffee on the third Sunday, Delphine knows.

name: Graham Fitch
summary: Chairs the vestry with the rector and leads the Tuesday buildings crew.
bio: Graham is a retired civil engineer who has personally re-pointed most of the north wall of the church.
